questions.question: Which South African provincial union has a team playing in the Women's Japan Premier League?
questions.explanation: A result of the partnership between Titans Cricket Union and Japan Cricket Association.

questions.question: Trisha Chetty set a database record (combined T20 + List A) with a value of 113. Which record is it?
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Most Wicketkeeping Dismissals', held by Trisha Chetty.

questions.question: At which ground did Jemma Botha record their career-best innings (43, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Bloemfontein Oval, against Knights on 2024/02/17.

questions.question: Which provincial union holds the record for 'Most Wins' (List A)?
At which ground did Dragons record their 'Highest Total' (List A)?

questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Eastern Storm or Rhinos?
